summary: Kerb of a multi-lane arterial with no parking and no room off the lane.
reasons: Kerb beside a traffic lane, no pull-out

drivers.seclusion: No dwellings within 45 m, but a van would sit in plain view beside fast traffic.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb sits against through lanes and a median; no verge or bay to pull fully out.
drivers.traffic: Heavy multi-lane arterial with turning lanes and a junction.
drivers.convention: No parked cars along this kerb and no marked parking lane.

sun_shade: Open to sun; trees only on the far north-west side.

best_section.where: Moggill Road median-side kerb opposite the car park entrance
